prereg_check.NOTE: sha256 of the remote blob is computed from `git show` text, which normalises nothing; compare it to the worktree hash to confirm the brief that governed this run is byte-identical to the one that was pushed.

NOTE_D: arm D (top-k by |h_i|) and arm A (top-p L1 on i) select by the SAME score because i IS h; at matched k they are the same mask and BPB_D == BPB_A exactly.  Run anyway as a determinism check.  D2 is the Builder's output-error-optimal ceiling, added beside D, never instead of it.

allocation_inventory.policy: every allocation that scales with the input, including the ones that fit

per_forward_batch.logits [B, T, V] fp32: 4*512*151936*4 B = 1.24 GB at B=4, T=512, V=151936 -- the LARGEST single allocation in the probe, and it is the LM head's, not the mask's; log_softmax allocates a second one of the same size, so the true transient is ~2.5 GB
per_forward_batch.h / g / u [B, T, F] fp32: 4*512*8960*4 B = 73 MB each at the 1.5B donor

per_layer_transient_mask.note: chunked over rows at MASK_CHUNK=512 precisely so these do NOT scale with B*T

persistent.model fp32: n_params * 4 B; 6.2 GB at 1.5B, 12.4 GB at 3B, 30.5 GB at 7B

NOT_allocated: no activation cache on disk (unlike F1's capture stage) -- every arm re-runs the forward
no [T, F] float mask is ever materialised; the mask is bool and multiplied in place
